subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: This creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin API, so the permanent contract, scopes, docs, and admin rotate semantics need maintainer intent beyond the mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve After Targeting Fix
options.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, docs/scope review, and a clean merge result before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until the runtime maintenance contract is clearer.

options.title: Defer Core Control API
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep context-engine maintenance control plugin-owned until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve After Targeting Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, docs/scope review, and a clean merge result before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the ContextEngine public contract, where jalehman has repeated feature-history ownership.
